items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I'd hear him play, get the sound of his notes, go all by myself in the lot, in the barn, play.

ctx.x: No, sir. Well, when I first learned how to play, my grandfather had an old five-string banjo. Mm-hmm. And so... When those fellas leave our home, I'd take that old banjo and go in there and start to grab a phone. Oh, you know those grab phones used to wind up? You know, Charlie Jackson record on
and get behind him. Oh, yeah. Papa Charlie. That's right.

I'd get behind him. I'd hear him play, get the sound of his notes, go all by myself in the lot, in the barn, play. Sometime my mother would be looking for me and I wouldn't answer. Sometime it'd be 8 o'clock before I'd get out of that barn.
